rows.finding: The reviewed index lists only unrelated later letters (annual amounts, domestic cruise ships and art). The inspected Tax Appeals Board case concerns earlier periods and a different foreign-business VAT-refund regulation1243/2019. Neither settles the certificate condition under Regulation194 after Act63/2024. The older Ministry HTML says one year, unlike the already-reviewed current regulation PDF’s two-year provision; that older HTML must not replace the current reviewed PDF.
rows.remaining: An actual current administrative or judicial reconciliation of the hypothetical-credit certificate limb with Article12(1)(2), plus actual buyer/fixed-establishment/local-service facts.
rows.recommendedPublicationAction: Retain the current scoped explanation; no new date or claimed resolution.

rows.actuallyRead: The actual official Gazette213/2021 text reader again exposes Articles1–2 of amendment3599 but no annex text. The full search results identify detailed CRM idV pages and a 2025 central-bank unofficial consolidation as leads; their bodies were not recovered.
rows.finding: All four annex screenshot requests timed out, and an ordinary direct GET to the known original Gazette PDF returned503. Detailed Macedonian idV10885 and Albanian idV10647 service pages timed out, as did the known public RDI landing page. The newly identified NBRM 37/2025 unofficial-consolidation PDF returned403. Long search previews contain apparently useful60-day/document/translation information, but they are not treated as actual complete source bodies or current verified instructions.
rows.remaining: Actual replacement DIR annex/current detailed procedure, fee and later-change reconciliation. Actual transaction and parties still determine linked filings.
rows.recommendedPublicationAction: Keep the existing 2021 form-replacement finding, preserve the explicit procedural gap; do not add the preview’s numerical clock or document list.

rows.actuallyRead: The government’s actual complete74th-session announcement dated11November2026, especially the foreign-exchange adoption section lines65–71.
rows.finding: The announcement confirms adoption and subjects, and says four repeal decisions were also adopted. It does not attach operative regulation text or identify gazettal/commencement. Searches for materially different official publication routes did not recover an actual body. The distinct medicine-list commencement language elsewhere on the same page must not be applied to the foreign-exchange regulation.
rows.remaining: The actual new Gazette text, commencement and repeal-transition provisions, followed by actual resident/account/payment facts.
rows.recommendedPublicationAction: Retain the adoption-versus-operative-law distinction; do not infer implementation dates from adjacent session decisions or secondary summaries.
